title: PLG signal pipeline: dashboards + alerts for HubSpot writes, lag, and volume anomalies
author: Allison Grant
description: Context: We’re rolling out the PLG→sales signal pipeline (aggregation → scoring/dedupe → HubSpot writer, optional Slack notifier). During pilot we lacked a single place to answer: “are signals generating?”, “are we falling behind?”, and “are HubSpot writes failing/retrying?”. This PR adds a Grafana dashboard and alert rules covering (1) HubSpot write failures/rate limits + DLQ growth, (2) end-to-end lag (event_time→written_time) and per-stage consumer lag, and (3) signal volume anomalies by type to catch both silent drops and runaway duplicates. Also adds explicit links to the oncall runbook and standardizes tags/labels so oncall can filter alerts quickly. Scope: dashboards (Grafana JSON/Jsonnet), Prometheus alert rules, and alert routing metadata. Non-goals: changing instrumentation in redwood/incident-bot repos (that’s in ENG-2843/2844); this PR assumes metrics emitted as of the latest pipeline deploy. Runbook: links to Confluence runbook “PLG Signal Routing Runbook” (eng-platform) and includes a short “verification checklist” panel in the dashboard. Rollout: safe to merge; alert rules are initially set to severity=warning for 72h (via mute timings) and can be promoted to page after pilot tuning. Testing: rendered dashboards in dev Grafana, validated rule syntax via promtool, and replayed a small prod snapshot to confirm labels match. Screenshots: see /docs/pr-447-plg-signal-pipeline-dashboard.png.

Caleb Johnson: The lag panel should be event_time→hubspot_written_time p95, not ingestion_time. Also add a breakdown for each stage so we can see where it’s backing up. Allison Grant: Updated recording rule to compute e2e lag using the exported event_time histogram and added stage panels for aggregator/scorer/writer consumer lag (kafka_exporter). Logan Wright: Volume anomaly alert is risky—how are we avoiding noisy pages on weekly seasonality? Allison Grant: Implemented as warning-only, uses 7d baseline with hour-of-day bucketing (avg_over_time on offset windows) and requires 3 consecutive evaluations. release_notes: Added PLG signal pipeline observability: new Grafana dashboard and alerting for HubSpot writer failures/rate limits, end-to-end lag, DLQ growth, and per-signal-type volume anomalies; includes runbook links for oncall triage.
